medical_caveats_from_the_source_project: The model depicts 'canonical' adult anatomy — an idealised reference, not an individual.
The underlying subject was a 22-year-old volunteer, so epiphysial disks and fusion lines are not fully closed. The project deliberately left these visible but shallow.
The project states: "Despite our best efforts, some errors may still be present."
Anatomy varies between individuals; depicted sizes and configurations are not universal.
